How can I withdraw cash? There are cash rewards for each level you pass. The more levels you pass, the more rewards you get. You can withdraw cash once you meet the withdrawal requirements. How long does it take to withdraw money? Generally, funds will be credited to your account within a few minutes. If the number of withdrawals or the withdrawal amount exceeds a certain limit, the system will review it. In this case, the funds will still be credited within 24 hours, so please don’t worry. Why did my withdrawal fail? If a withdrawal fails, the system will provide the reason in English. Please modify your information according to the prompt. If the withdrawal fails, the withdrawal amount will be returned automatically. You can update your information and initiate the withdrawal again. Please make sure all the information you provide is correct. We are not responsible for withdrawal failures caused by incorrect information. How many times can I withdraw? Unlimited. How many times can I withdraw per day? Up to 5 times per day. Why can’t I withdraw funds using my withdrawal account? The same withdrawal account can be bound to a maximum of two app accounts. Please do not share your withdrawal account with others. Can I use a VPN? The use of VPN is strictly prohibited. Please do not use a VPN while using the app.

Como sacar dinheiro? Há recompensas em dinheiro para cada nível concluído. Quanto mais níveis você passar, maiores serão as recompensas. Você poderá sacar após atender aos requisitos. Quanto tempo leva para sacar? Normalmente, o valor é creditado em poucos minutos. Caso o número de saques ou o valor ultrapasse o limite, o sistema fará uma revisão. Nesse caso, o valor será creditado em até 24 horas. Por que meu saque falhou? Se o saque falhar, o sistema informará o motivo em inglês. Corrija as informações conforme solicitado. O valor será devolvido automaticamente. Não nos responsabilizamos por falhas causadas por informações incorretas. Quantas vezes posso sacar? Ilimitado. Quantas vezes posso sacar por dia? Até 5 vezes por dia. Por que não consigo sacar usando minha conta? A mesma conta de saque pode ser vinculada a no máximo duas contas do app. Posso usar VPN? O uso de VPN é estritamente proibido.

Bagaimana cara menarik uang? Ada hadiah uang untuk setiap level yang Anda selesaikan. Semakin banyak level, semakin besar hadiahnya. Penarikan tersedia setelah memenuhi syarat. Berapa lama proses penarikan? Biasanya dana masuk dalam beberapa menit. Jika jumlah atau nominal penarikan melebihi batas, sistem akan meninjau. Dana akan masuk dalam waktu 24 jam. Mengapa penarikan gagal? Jika penarikan gagal, sistem akan menampilkan alasannya dalam bahasa Inggris. Perbarui informasi Anda. Dana akan dikembalikan otomatis. Kami tidak bertanggung jawab atas kesalahan informasi. Berapa kali bisa menarik? Tidak terbatas. Berapa kali per hari? Maksimal 5 kali per hari. Mengapa akun penarikan tidak bisa digunakan? Satu akun penarikan hanya dapat dihubungkan ke dua akun aplikasi. Bolehkah menggunakan VPN? Penggunaan VPN dilarang keras.
